device.description: 12-bit 500 kSPS 8-channel SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface
device.note: adc78h90.pdf (SNAS227D) p.1-2 connection diagram and pin descriptions, p.3 operating ratings, p.4 digital characteristics (output coding straight binary), p.5 timing specifications, p.6 serial timing diagram (Figure 4), p.12-13 serial interface and control register (Tables 1-3), p.14 transfer function

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the Control Register loaded from DIN on the first 8 rising SCLK edges of each 16-clock conversion (DONTC DONTC ADD2 ADD1 ADD0 DONTC DONTC DONTC, Table 1 p.12); no read-back; power-up value all zeros (AIN1)

commands.name: Control Register
commands.note: each 16-SCLK conversion clocks the control byte in on DIN (bits 5-3 = ADD2-ADD0 select the input of the next conversion), the last 8 DIN bits are ignored; DOUT gives 4 leading zeros then DB11-DB0 (p.12, Figure 4)

pages: p.1-2 (pins), p.3 (operating ratings: AVDD 2.7-5.25 V, DVDD 2.7 V-AVDD), p.4 (straight binary), p.5 (t2 30 ns, t3 30 ns, t8 20 ns max; tCONV 13 SCLK), p.6 (Figure 4), p.12-13 (Tables 1-3: ADD2-ADD0 select AIN1-AIN8), p.14 (transfer function)
notModeled: analog inputs and multiplexer; the conversion is clocked by SCLK (13 SCLK cycles), not timed: the result is the 0 V code 0x000 at once
the channel written in a frame applies to the next conversion (one-sample delay); with every result the 0 V code this has no visible effect (ADD is stored only)
continuous conversion frames (N x 16 SCLKs per CS low) are approximated by repeating the 16-bit output pattern and re-matching the control word every 16 bits

SPI mode 3 chosen (DOUT changes on SCLK falling edges, DIN and DOUT sampled on rising edges); the datasheet allows SCLK high or low at CS fall (with SCLK low, CS fall acts as the first falling edge; the first leading zero may then not be set up in time)
power-down while CS is high (no digital effect); t1a/t1b setup, SCLK 50 kHz-8 MHz and duty-cycle limits
AVDD is also the reference; DVDD 2.7 V to AVDD and digital inputs 0 V to AVDD (vcc 2.7-5.25 V)
variants: ADC78H89 is the 7-channel version (pin 2 NC, ADD = 111 selects GND), separate datasheet and spec
